summary: Quiet St Lucia street kerb backing onto golf course bush, homes across the road.
reasons: Backs onto golf course and bush
Quiet residential street, no parking convention

drivers.seclusion: West side is tree belt and golf course; dwellings sit across the road, 19 m or more from the middle.

drivers.traffic: Narrow residential street, light traffic likely.
drivers.convention: 2P resident-permit signs weekdays 7am-6pm; no cars seen parked along this kerb.

flags: Mild slope: about 3% over the section

sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the kerb; shaded most of the day, golf course open to the west.
